panels.title: PV-Leistung

targets.query:
import "timezone"
import "math"
import "date"
option location = timezone.location(name: "Europe/Berlin")
from(bucket: "nexa")
  |> range(start: -1h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "nexa" and (r._field == "pv1Voltage" or r._field == "pv1Current" or r._field == "pv2Voltage" or r._field == "pv2Current" or r._field == "pv3Voltage" or r._field == "pv3Current" or r._field == "pv4Voltage" or r._field == "pv4Current" or r._field == "onGridPower"))
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r.onGridPower and exists r.pv1Voltage)
  |> last(column: "onGridPower")
  |> map(fn: (r) => {
      pv = r.pv1Voltage * r.pv1Current + r.pv2Voltage * r.pv2Current + r.pv3Voltage * r.pv3Current + r.pv4Voltage * r.pv4Current
      out = (r.onGridPower - 30000.0)
      return { _time: r._time, _value: pv }
    })
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])

import "timezone"

import "date"
option location = timezone.location(name: "Europe/Berlin")

  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)

      out = (r.onGridPower - 30000.0)

    })
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "PV", "Ins Haus", "Batterie (+ laden / − entladen)"])

option location = timezone.location(name: "Europe/Berlin")
from(bucket: "nexa")
  |> range(start: -30d)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "nexa" and (r._field == "pv1Voltage" or r._field == "pv1Current" or r._field == "pv2Voltage" or r._field == "pv2Current" or r._field == "pv3Voltage" or r._field == "pv3Current" or r._field == "pv4Voltage" or r._field == "pv4Current" or r._field == "onGridPower"))
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1m, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r.onGridPower and exists r.pv1Voltage)
  |> map(fn: (r) => {
      pv = r.pv1Voltage * r.pv1Current + r.pv2Voltage * r.pv2Current + r.pv3Voltage * r.pv3Current + r.pv4Voltage * r.pv4Current
      out = (r.onGridPower - 30000.0)
      return { r with _value: pv }
    })
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1d, fn: (tables=<-, column) => tables |> integral(unit: 1h, column: column), timeSrc: "_start", createEmpty: false)
  |> timeShift(duration: 12h)

  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])
